message: The following plugins have been deprecated: **CLS Azure Sentinel**, **CTE Illumio**, and **CLS AWS CloudTrail Lake**. Customers are advised to migrate to the recommended replacement plugins. Details can be found in the respective KB articles: [CLS Azure Sentinel](https://docs.netskope.com/en/cloud-exchange-kb-articles#microsoft-azure-sentinel-plugin-for-log-shipper-module-deprecation), [CTE Illumio](https://docs.netskope.com/en/cloud-exchange-kb-articles#illumio-plugin-for-threat-exchange-module-deprecation), and [CLS AWS CloudTrail Lake](https://docs.netskope.com/en/cloud-exchange-faqs#q--the-aws-cloudtrail-lake-plugin-has-been-deprecated-in-cloud-exchange--what-is-the-recommended-alternative-).

Cloud Exchange v7.0.0 is NOW GA, please refer to [community article](https://community.netskope.com/netskope-cloud-exchange-ce-67/netskope-cloud-exchange-ce-v7-0-0-is-now-ga-9086) for details. We strongly recommend that customers **deploy, upgrade, or migrate to CE v7.0.0** to take advantage of the latest features, critical bug fixes and security updates, helping to strengthen the security posture of their digital ecosystem. Please refer to the [release notes](https://docs.netskope.com/en/netskope-cloud-exchange-release-notes-version-7-0-0), [upgrade](https://docs.netskope.com/en/upgrade-cloud-exchange) and [migration](https://docs.netskope.com/en/migrate-cloud-exchange) documentation for more details.

**Netskope DLPx** is NOW GA with Cloud Exchange v7.0.0, bringing **Exact Data Match (EDM)** and **Custom File Classifier (CFC)** workflows to Cloud Exchange. Please refer to the [release notes](https://docs.netskope.com/en/netskope-cloud-exchange-release-notes-version-7-0-0), [upgrade guide](https://docs.netskope.com/en/upgrade-cloud-exchange), [EDM guide](https://docs.netskope.com/en/exact-data-match-module), [CFC guide](https://docs.netskope.com/en/custom-file-classification-module) and [sizing guidelines](https://docs.netskope.com/en/cloud-exchange-system-requirements#sizing-the-system-based-on-anticipated-usage-for-edm-and-cfc-modules) for more details.

Cloud Exchange versions **v5.0.1**, **v5.1.0**, **v5.1.1**, and **v5.1.2** have reached End of Life, please upgrade to the latest CE version and refer to [product life cycle](https://docs.netskope.com/en/about-cloud-exchange#block-a4ca387a-bc38-40ea-b4bc-fcb3d2ff37ba) for more details.
